blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The verified CapToken implementation behind the tracked Ethereum cUSD proxy exposes pauseProtocol() and pauseAsset(), which can halt transfers at the protocol or individual reserve-asset scope. Cap's documentation identifies the tracked cUSD deployment and its governance-controlled vault; the reviewed source therefore establishes direct system-wide transfer-pause capability for cUSD. Reserve and route dependencies add separate upstream exposure.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: cUSD has native issuance on Ethereum through Cap's collateralized vault and on Tempo through a separate TIP-20 issuer path. MegaETH is a LayerZero OFT V2 burn-and-mint representation whose owner-controlled OFT and Ethereum-side OFT lockbox are assessed here with their 1-day timelocks, Cap Safe governance, peer wiring, lockbox accounting, and unresolved DVN, executor, and route-limit details; these bridge capabilities are not Mint Authority.

routes.reviewNote: Canonical home deployment: cUSD is issued on Ethereum through Cap's collateralized vault (verified mint-authority review 2026-07-14; governance = 3-of-5 Safe 0xb8FC49402dF3ee4f8587268FB89fda4d621a8793 behind a 1-day TimelockController).

LayerZero OFT V2 representation of Ethereum-native cUSD: endpoint() reads 0x6F475642a6e85809B1c36Fa62763669b1b48DD5B (eid 30398) with sole peer the Ethereum OFT Adapter lockbox 0xa62571ebdffabc3051a2e5b9e1f57b23d830c8fd (read 2026-07-19). The MegaETH OFT owner is Cap's MegaETH TimelockController 0x0000000035A7744F94e6949431CE20EA77312a55 behind the same 3-of-5 Cap Safe through a 1-day delay.

Issuer-native Tempo deployment: the token sits in Tempo's TIP-20 precompile address space and its ISSUER_ROLE is held by Cap's own issuer proxy 0xbd12e50bfaa25735d074dbfdcf73208b9ccd2e43 (UUPS; owner = Tempo TimelockController 0x0000000035A7744F94e6949431CE20EA77312a55 behind the 3-of-5 Cap Safe, read 2026-07-20). No bridge mints this deployment.

controls.capDescription: The MegaETH LayerZero OFT burn-and-mint representation is owner-controlled through the 86400-second timelock; no independent aggregate or per-call route limit was resolved.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: The Ethereum OFT lockbox holds canonical cUSD for the LayerZero route; MegaETH credits the representation through validated burn-and-mint messages rather than Cap's collateral vault.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: At MegaETH block 24121081, endpoint() returned 0x6F475642a6e85809B1c36Fa62763669b1b48DD5B and peers(30101) returned the bytes32-padded Ethereum OFT lockbox 0xa62571ebdffabc3051a2e5b9e1f57b23d830c8fd. The OFT owner can change peer configuration.
routeChecks.attestorQuorum: LayerZero Endpoint, DVN, and executor validation is an external protocol failure domain. Current cUSD-specific DVN and executor configuration was not independently resolved, so no favorable validator claim is made.
routeChecks.rateLimits: No cUSD-specific aggregate or per-route rate-limit control was found in the reviewed evidence; current route limits remain unresolved.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At MegaETH block 24121081, the cUSD proxy resolved to verified L2TokenUpgradeable implementation 0x3b2bf0834130878e0568b8047061a77e234ef37b, owner() returned TimelockController 0x0000000035A7744F94e6949431CE20EA77312a55, and the one-day timelock was administered through the same 3-of-5 Cap Safe. Existing Safe evidence records the five owners, threshold 3, no enabled modules, and zero guard at block 21230596; current direct guard and module-pagination calls were not decodable through the public RPC and are not treated as fresh confirmation.

The timelock delay is 86400 seconds and the same Cap Safe is 3-of-5 with the five owners recorded above. The OFT owner therefore controls bridge mint/burn administration, upgrades, and peer configuration; LayerZero DVN/executor state and route-specific limits remain unresolved.
